mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO student (student_no, name, gender, major, stu_class, class_id, age, score, enroll_date, status) VALUES
(#{s.studentNo}, #{s.name}, #{s.gender}, #{s.major}, #{s.stuClass}, #{s.classId}, #{s.age}, #{s.score}, #{s.enrollDate}, #{s.status})
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_no, s.name, s.gender, s.major, s.stu_class, s.class_id, s.age, s.score, s.enroll_date, s.status, c.teacher_name, c.class_room FROM student s LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.class_id

SELECT s.student_id, s.student_no, s.name, s.gender, s.major, s.stu_class, s.class_id, s.age, s.score, s.enroll_date, s.status, c.teacher_name, c.class_room, co.course_id, co.course_name, co.credit, co.course_teacher FROM student s LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN stu_course sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id LEFT JOIN course co ON sc.course_id = co.course_id ORDER BY s.student_id

SELECT co.course_id AS courseId, co.course_name AS courseName, COUNT(sc.student_id) AS enrollCount FROM course co LEFT JOIN stu_course sc ON co.course_id = sc.course_id GROUP BY co.course_id, co.course_name ORDER BY co.course_id
